item.title: Hopes and Plans
item.description:
We are so grateful that the Lord has made a way for all of us to be in the Pacific Northwest during our pre-field ministry (deputation) days.

We are praying that the door will be open for us to return to Japan in the spring of 2027. In order to do so, we must first be fully supported financially. Currently, we are at over 80% of required support!

Please join us in prayer for the brothers and sisters back in Japan and for those who are not yet in God’s family, that they would respond to the gospel message with repentance and faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. Pray also that we woudl patiently wait for the Lord's timing on our return to Japan.

item.title: The Strattons
item.description:
The following video will give you an clear idea about Nate and Azusa's direction in ministry.

Nathan (Nate) and Azusa met in Eugene, Oregon in late spring of 2000: He was a student at Eugene Bible College, working on his bachelor’s degree in missionary studies after having spent two years as a short-term missionary in a church in Yokohama, Japan. She was in the U.S. taking classes at Lane Community College and then later at Eugene Bible College, working on improving her English skills and learning about ministry.
